# CAD Touch

> CAD Touch is a fast DWG and DXF viewer for Android and Windows, made for engineers and site work. It opens drawings offline, with no ads and no account, and lets you pin numbered notes with photos to the drawing and hand over a PDF report.

Maker: Marko Nedic software, an independent developer (hello@cadtouch.app).

## Facts

- Android app: "CAD Touch: DWG + Photo Notes" on Google Play, package com.markonedic.cadtouch, Android 8.0 or newer, 15 languages.
- Windows app: "CAD Touch Lite (DWG & DXF Viewer)" in the Microsoft Store, Windows 10 (1809 or newer) and Windows 11, x64 and ARM64, 13 languages.
- iPhone, iPad and Mac: coming soon on the App Store.
- Opens DWG (AutoCAD R13 to 2018 and newer) and DXF. It is a viewer: it does not edit or save drawings.
- No ads, no sign-up, no login. Works without an internet connection. Drawings, notes and photos stay on the device.
- Measuring with snapping to line ends and midpoints; layers on and off; light or dark background.
- Notes: a numbered pin on the drawing with text, photos, a status (open or resolved) and the contractor; a PDF report of all notes or of a filter.
- Price on Android: installing, opening and viewing drawings and measuring one distance at a time are free. A Pro subscription through Google Play (first month free for new subscribers) adds the other measurements, notes with photos and the PDF report. Windows and Android purchases are separate.
- Speed test (our own, November 11, 2026, Galaxy Z Fold 2, one 21.9 MB DWG with about 429,000 objects, median of 5 runs): CAD Touch 3.2 s first open and 0.8 s again; the fastest of the 7 free-to-download DWG apps tested. Results depend on the device and the drawing.
